text:
tara: Quick heads-up, PR #5230 (sdk-snippets + migration guide) failed docs-preview: md-lint line-length (2x), linkcheck (anchor -> /sdk/python/#client-usage), and a Vale passive-voice flag. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/8230

docs-bot: docs-preview results for PR 5230 \u2014 checks: md-lint (2), linkcheck (1), vale (1). Full log: https://ci.redwood.ai/8230/logs

evan: I can trim the long lines in the SDK snippet file. Are we allowed to reflow code comments to avoid changing code blocks?

maria: Keep code blocks exact; only reflow prose. For the snippet comments, shorten to one-line descriptions or move details to a note below.

zach: Linkcheck broken anchor: the header id changed when we normalized 'Client usage' -> 'client-usage-guide'. Suggest updating link to `#client-usage-guide`.

toni: Vale flagged "is recommended" passive voice in migration.md. Quick fix: change to "We recommend" or "Use X to do Y". Prefer active voice.

tara: I'll push two commits: (1) wrap long lines in sdk/snippets/python.md prose (not code), (2) fix anchor in migration guide, (3) replace passive phrasing. Running `make docs-md-lint` locally.

evan: When wrapping, use hard line breaks at ~88 cols to satisfy md-lint rule. Add a brief note in PR description about not changing code blocks.

maria: Also run `make docs-linkcheck` locally; some local people hit false positives when GitHub pages redirect.

docs-bot: CI queued for PR 5230 \u2014 build 8230 started

tara: pushed commits, local md-lint clean, local linkcheck OK. Commit message: `Fix: wrap sdk prose, update anchor to '#client-usage-guide', rephrase passive voice`

docs-bot: docs-preview success for PR 5230 \u2014 all checks passed

evan: dropping an approval. Small nit in comment wording but non-blocking.

maria: approving, will merge during docs merge window at 16:30 PT.

zach: merged at 16:34 PT. Thanks all :tada:
